info.title: Prumo API
info.description: API of Prumo. The web app and the Android app are clients of this contract.

get.description: Liveness and database check. No authentication, no version prefix.

post.description: Creates a session. Web gets an HttpOnly cookie; the app gets the token in the body.

get.description: Active sessions of the current user, most recently used first.

delete.description: Revokes one of the current user's sessions (any device).

put.description: Changes the password (requires the current one) and revokes every other session.

get.description: Installed modules in the user's order, with their enabled state.
Home screen data: the summary of each enabled module.
Month summary of all vehicles (fuel, km driven) and the next oil change due.

ActivityItem.title: ActivityItem
ActivityItem.description: A recent record ("Atividade recente" on Início).

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Summaries of the enabled modules, in the user's order.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.description: Due items of the enabled modules (next 60 days), by date.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Recent records of the enabled modules, newest first.

fuel_type.description: Defaults to the vehicle's usual fuel (required if it has none).

consumption_km_l.title: Consumption Km L
consumption_km_l.description: km/l of the full-tank cycle this fueling closes (G8), 2 decimals.

client.description: `web`: the session goes in the `prumo_session` cookie. `app`: the token is returned in the body, to be sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

device_name.title: Device Name
device_name.description: Shown in the session list. Web derives it if omitted.

remember.title: Remember
remember.description: Web only. `false` creates a short session whose cookie ends with the browser.

token.title: Token
token.description: Session token. Only returned when `client` is `app`.

workshop_name.title: Workshop Name
workshop_name.description: Used when `workshop_id` is absent; creates the workshop if new.

next_oil_change_km.title: Next Oil Change Km
next_oil_change_km.description: Absent: suggested from the interval. `null`: no forecast.

next_oil_change_on.title: Next Oil Change On
next_oil_change_on.description: Absent: suggested from the interval. `null`: no forecast.

MaintenanceUpdate.title: MaintenanceUpdate
MaintenanceUpdate.description: Partial update. `items`, when present, replaces all the items.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enabled for the current user (a preference, not a permission).

position.title: Position
position.description: Position in the user's navigation and dashboard order.

due_on.title: Due On
due_on.description: Expected day (pace for km, date otherwise).

used_km_percent.title: Used Km Percent
used_km_percent.description: 0-100: share of the km interval used.

used_days_percent.title: Used Days Percent
used_days_percent.description: 0-100: share of the time interval used.

estimated_km_on.title: Estimated Km On
estimated_km_on.description: When the km criterion should be due at the current pace (G12).

OilChangeRead.title: OilChangeRead
OilChangeRead.description: G6. `null` on the vehicle when it has no oil interval (G1).

estimated_km_on.title: Estimated Km On
estimated_km_on.description: When the suggested km would be reached.

previous_oil_types.title: Previous Oil Types
previous_oil_types.description: Oils used before, most recent first.

enabled_modules.title: Enabled Modules
enabled_modules.description: Enabled module ids, in navigation and dashboard order.

enabled_modules.title: Enabled Modules
enabled_modules.description: Ordered list of enabled module ids. Installed modules left out are disabled.

PreferencesUpdate.title: PreferencesUpdate
PreferencesUpdate.description: Partial update: absent fields are left unchanged. None of these fields accepts null.

current.title: Current
current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: What it is about, such as the vehicle name.

data.title: Data
data.description: Values of the event, documented per `kind`.

UpcomingItem.title: UpcomingItem
UpcomingItem.description: Something due on a day ("Vem aí" on Início): an oil change, an invoice closing…

current_km.title: Current Km
current_km.description: Odometer at registration; creates the first reading.

current_km.title: Current Km
current_km.description: A different value records a manual reading now.
